interpretation_rules: Each outcome is for its own full command/JUnit denominator; a passing target case does not convert a failing aggregate to PASS.
The 86/86 f1df wave includes 16 B18 numeric-container testcases; do not add the 86-case count to other waves or relabel all 86 as B18.
The e848 and 814 invocations include unrelated sibling checks; their aggregate FAIL remains recorded with per-target B18 results separately stated.
The B18 zero controls are fixture-local outputs of actual registered engines. They do not establish causal correctness, external units/time semantics, calibrated evidence, or N9 authority.
The manual fresh-GET failure occurs before N5 at VerifiedNLJobScope binding; it is not a B18 numeric parser failure and supplies no served GET positive.
The later 98bfc manual-route fixture observation is supplemental and non-B18: it is outside the five checks and their testcase denominators, and it does not establish fresh GET completion.
